item.title: New revelations in Cornell sexual assault case spark outrage
item.description: The alleged victim of a 2024 gang rape at Cornell University clearly said in her police statement that she was sexually assaulted, her attorney told NPR — counter to what a prosecutor has claimed.

item.title: The family of Renee Good files lawsuits over her death during Minneapolis ICE raids
item.description: The fatal shooting of Renee Good by a federal immigration agent last January in Minneapolis set off a firestorm of protests around the U.S. Her family is speaking out for the first time.

item.title: U.S. military forces formally left Iraq today, marking a new era
item.description: The U.S. military has been in Iraq for much of the past 35 years. A low-key ceremony Wednesday marked the formal departure of U.S. forces at a time when Iraq is still facing an uncertain future.

item.title: How WNBA star Gabby Williams carries her $1 billion team
item.description: The Golden State Valkyries lead their playoff series 1-0 after the heroics of Gabby Williams. The former UConn star has one of the WNBA's latest expansion teams playing with incredible team chemistry.
